scope: Independent direct-node native PostgreSQL acceptance using the existing shared compiled build. No build invoked by this verifier.

environment.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

commands: LC_ALL=C LANG=C COMMUNITY_POSTGRES_MODE=host COMMUNITY_DURABLE_TRIAL=1 COMMUNITY_SOAK_SECONDS=30 node scripts/verify-community-local.ts
limitations: First restricted-sandbox community attempt failed before database startup because native shared memory was denied; the recorded successful run used approved escalation.
Both harnesses create and remove their own SCRAM-authenticated loopback PostgreSQL clusters, use synthetic identities, and load no .env or hosted database URL.
30-second local synthetic load is smoke acceptance, not long-duration hosted audience capacity approval.
Replay uses real local FFmpeg and PostgreSQL with a synthetic in-memory object adapter; no hosted S3/R2/edge/provider media or physical-device acceptance.

Three unrelated account-session/UI files changed during the trial, so this is not a claim of one fully frozen browser asset revision. The exact before/after hashes are retained. Server source, compiled server, migrations and harness dependencies stayed unchanged; the lead reviewed that these account controls do not alter community or replay behavior.
